description: P4 impact ground truth of the deterministic fixture repository. The pair is the two reproducible commits created by scripts/fixture-codeintel-repo.ps1; the changed refund call/route/component must surface the R1 requirement and therefore the case sourced from R1. The runner compares the P4 analysis candidates (selected requirement candidates) against this expectation: recall = expected cases hit / expected cases, precision = hit candidates / selected requirement candidates.
